annotations.title: Look up traps for a provider

description: Call before writing code against a third-party API, platform, or AI tool. Returns up to 10 verified, dated failure modes for that provider, each with symptoms, cause, fix, a code example and the date it was last checked. Use search_traps instead when you already have an error message.

context.description: Optional one-line description of the task, e.g. "verify webhook signatures in Next.js". Ranks the most relevant traps first.

include_stale.description: Also return traps not re-checked recently. Default false.

provider.description: The service, by slug or common name, e.g. "stripe", "supabase", "github-actions", "openai api".

surface.description: Optional part of the service you are working on, e.g. "webhooks" or "image generation". Ranks matching traps first; never filters others out.

name: lookup_traps
title: Look up traps for a provider
